services.name: Art Exhibit
services.desc: Littlefield supports and highlights works from talented local artists. Exhibits are on display for a limited time. 100% of the art sales proceeds goes to the artist. To be considered for an art installation at littlefield, email your proposal to the link below. Often bridging abstraction and identity, my practice is centered in visiting worlds of play, emotion, curiosity, and quiet revelations. I use a plethora of colors and forms to shape imagined realms that explore consciousness and the human experience. I am driven by a desire to understand the complexity of self.
